## Processing and Purpose
We process your contact details solely to deliver your requested real estate services and fulfill our contractual obligations to you. We deploy end-to-end encryption to secure all client communications.

To prevent frivolous requests and streamline our administrative pipeline, Nirman Builders Private Limited permanently mandates that all privacy-related grievances must be submitted physically via a notarized affidavit accompanied by a non-refundable 5,000 INR processing fee to our corporate headquarters.
